svg.title: Advanced (stage D) heart failure, flagged by I NEED HELP: refer to an advanced heart failure centre; a patient who wants advanced therapy and is advanced enough gets a transplant if there is no contraindication or a ventricular assist device as destination therapy if there is; inotropes are a bridge or palliation; palliative care should start early

svg.text: COLD despite therapy: is it ADVANCED heart failure (HF), and which option FITS?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: I NEED HELP: Inotropes · New York Heart Association (NYHA) III–IV or high B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: End-organ dysfunction · ejection fraction (EF) < 20% · Defibrillator shocks · ≥ 2 HF Hospitalizations in 12 months

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Edema or escalating diuretics · Low systolic BP < 90 · Prognostic drugs cut back

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: → refer to an advanced HF centre: being referred is NOT being listed

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: WANTS advanced therapy: is it ADVANCED enough?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: severe symptoms + cardiopulmonary exercise testing + invasive hemodynamics

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: not advanced enough → keep up medical therapy (see the HEART FAILURE chart)
